parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $dx=3\sec^2\theta\,d\theta$. B1. Substitute throughout for $x$ and $dx$. M1. Obtain any correct form in $\theta$, for example $\int\dfrac{81\sec^2\theta}{(9+9\tan^2\theta)^2}\,d\theta$. A1. Justify the change of limits and obtain $\int_0^{\pi/4}\cos^2\theta\,d\theta$ correctly. A1 AG. Total 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Obtain an indefinite integral of the form $\int(a+b\cos2\theta)\,d\theta$, with $ab\ne0$. M1. Obtain $\dfrac12\theta+\dfrac14\sin2\theta$. A1. Use the correct limits in an expression containing $p\theta+q\sin2\theta$, with $pq\ne0$. DM1. Obtain $\dfrac18(\pi+2)$, or an exact equivalent such as $\frac18\pi+\frac14$. A1. Total 4.
